scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Do you want to build connections without being in a guild?
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
您想在不加入公会的情况下建立人脉吗？

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Can't find the perfect guild for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
找不到适合自己的完美公会吗？

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
You can join or leave clans freely! Just join!
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
您可以自由地加入或退出氏族！直接加入吧！

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Now, come on in and meet the masters of the Kingdom's best clans!
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
现在，请进来见见王国最强氏族的师父们吧！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Hi! I'm Raffam, master of the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你好！我是拉法姆，卢恩·米德加兹王国^3131FF剑氏族^000000的师父。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族资讯

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Sword Clan
scripts.translation: 关于剑氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are a type of guild ran by the Kingdom.
They don't participate in the Siege, so members are free to join/leave anytime.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王国管理的一种公会。
它们不参与攻城战，因此成员可以随时自由加入或退出。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
I wish we could join the Siege. I'd love flying over on my dragon and burning everyone in my way!
Oops, too thrilled!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
真希望能参加攻城战。我想骑着龙飞过去，把挡路的人都烧掉！
哎呀，太兴奋了！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Join us, if no Clan suits your taste.
New members are given ^3131FFfree stat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
如果没有合适的氏族，就加入我们吧。
新成员将获得^3131FF免费的状态加成^000000。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Melee stats are offered as the name ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 suggests, but not all members are Melee classes.
Don't feel pressured, just count on me!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
正如^3131FF剑氏族^000000的名字所示，我们提供近战状态加成，但并非所有成员都是近战职业。
别有压力，尽管放心交给我！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Differences in variety creates the fun.
These odd bunches never bore me in the party.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
多样的差异才造就了乐趣。
这群怪人在一起组队时，从来不会让我感到无聊。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
And who knows you might meet your soul mate in the Clan? Hahah!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
说不定你还能在氏族里遇到你的灵魂伴侣呢？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
The ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 mainly supports Melee adventurers.
Join for free ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
^3131FF剑氏族^000000主要支持近战冒险者。
免费加入即可获得^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Remember, no Siege participation.
You should contact other guilds for Siege.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
请记住，氏族不参与攻城战。
如果您想参加攻城战，应该联系其他公会。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
A question?
Excited to join me? Hahah!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
有什么问题吗？
迫不及待想加入了吗？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Oh, you'll join? Good choice!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
哦，你要加入？不错的选择！
让我们先查看氏族政策，开始入会程序吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
You with me so far?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参与攻城战。
新成员将获得以下状态加成：^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你明白了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Clan masters exist for reason, like I.
Understood?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你可以随时加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超过2周^000000未登录，你将被^FF0000驱逐^000000。
氏族长老的存在是有原因的，比如我。
明白了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Great, sign your name here to register.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
很好，请在这里签名以完成注册。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
So, you're ^3131FF{0}^000000! Nice name!
Let me register you.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
原来你是^3131FF{0}^000000！名字不错！
让我为你办理注册。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Come back to join after you leave your current guild.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
请先退出你当前的公会，然后再回来加入。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Eh? Oh, you're in a Clan.
Don't mess with me, it's not cool!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
咦？哦，你已经在氏族里了。
别开玩笑了，这很不酷！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Welcome to the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000!
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
At your service!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
欢迎来到^3131FF剑氏族^000000！
你可以按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000查看氏族信息。
随时为您服务！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
哎呀。让我们从头开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
哎呀。让我们从头开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
You want to leave?
No problem. I hope you'll find a more suitable Clan.
Ready for withdrawal?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你想退出？
没问题。希望你能找到更合适的氏族。
准备好退出了吗？

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Wait, you're not with us! Grr, don't make me breathe fire at you!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
等等，你不在我们这里！哼，别逼我对你喷火！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Hey, talk to your guild master if you want to leave.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
嘿，如果你想退出，去和你的公会会长谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Okay, it's done. But let's not be strangers, okay?
It was nice having you!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
好了，办完了。但我们别做陌生人，好吗？
很高兴有你！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
I'm Devon, master of the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
我是德文，^3131FF言灵氏族^000000的长老。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族资讯

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Arc Wand Clan
scripts.translation: 关于言灵氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are ran by the Kingdom, not privately like others.
And I manage one of them.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王国管理的，不像其他组织那样是私人的。
而我负责管理其中一个。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
What's with that look? You got a problem?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...
你这是什么表情？你有意见吗？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Brother, you're scaring a potential member, be nice.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哥哥，你吓到潜在的成员了，请客气点。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Join if you are seeking a place to fit in. We give ^3131FFfree bonus stats^000000. But no Siege participation.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
如果你正在寻找一个归属的地方，可以加入。我们提供^3131FF免费的状态加成^000000。但不能参与攻城战。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Most members are offensive Mage classes as the name ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 suggests, but that's no requirement.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
正如^3131FF言灵氏族^000000的名字所暗示的那样，大多数成员是攻击型魔法师职业，但这不是必要条件。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...Hey, Shaam Rumi.
Stop hitting on my brother and get to work.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...嘿，沙姆·鲁米。
别老缠着我哥哥，快去干活。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
随便你！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...Hmpf!
Listen, Crossbow Clan's master is evil.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...哼！
听着，十字弓公会的师父是个坏人。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Get over me, Devon! Don't spread rumors!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
别缠着我，德文！别到处造谣！

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Haha. Stop it. You two are making a scene.
Come on, back to work guys.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哈哈。够了。你们两个别闹了。
好了，大家继续工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
The ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 mainly supports offensive Mage classes.
We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members. Don't ask for more; it's the Kingdom's rule.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF言灵氏族^000000主要支持攻击型魔法师职业。
我们为新成员提供^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。别要求更多了；这是王国的规定。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 can't participate in the Siege.
If you like the Siege, then go join a regular guild.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参与攻城战。
如果你喜欢攻城战，那就去加入普通的公会吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
That is all. No questions.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
就这些。别问问题。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...
那我们来看看氏族政策，开始入会程序吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
You with me so far?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参与攻城战。
新成员将获得这些状态加成：^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你听懂了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你可以随时加入或离开氏族，但如果你^FF0000超过2周^000000未登录，你将被^FF0000开除^000000。
你同意吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Sign your name here.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
在这里签上你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FF{0}^000000.....
Good, let me invite you in.

[Devon Aire]
Leave your guild first to join my Clan, duh.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
想加入我的氏族，先退出你的公会，笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You're already in a Clan. You joking?!
Oh, I can be funny, too--FIRE PILLAR!
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你已经在某个氏族里了。你在开玩笑吗？！
哦，我也会开玩笑的——火柱攻击！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You have joined the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你已加入^3131FF言灵氏族^000000。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
So don't bother me later.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你可以用^3131FFCtrl+G^000000查看氏族信息。
所以别再来烦我了。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
That's all. Visit often or be expelled. Dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
就这些。经常来，否则会被开除。解散。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Then I don't want you.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
那我不要你了。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Gosh, listen to the policy again.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
天哪，再听一遍政策吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Want to leave, huh?
I understand, it's about Sieges. If not, why are..Never mind..
I'll process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
想退会吗？
我理解，大概是因为攻城战吧。如果不是的话……算了……
我会处理你的退会申请。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Naughty children deserve a good Jupitel Thunder.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
不听话的孩子，就该尝尝雷鸣术的滋味。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You're barking up the wrong tree. Go to your Clan master.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你找错人了。去找你的氏族长吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You are withdrawn from the Clan.
Now leave. I don't feel like talking anymore.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你已退出氏族。
现在离开吧。我不想再说话了。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Nice to meet you. I'm Berman Aire, master of the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
I'm also the older brother of Devon Aire. Devon looks tough, but he's kind hearted.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
很高兴见到你。我是^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000的长，伯曼·艾尔。
我也是德文·艾尔的哥哥。德文虽然看起来凶，但心地很善良。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族资讯

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Golden Mace Clan
scripts.translation: 关于黄金之锤氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are established by the Kingdom to help adventurers connect and share information.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王国设立的，旨在帮助冒险者建立联系并分享信息。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Because the Kingdom runs the Clan, there is no Siege participation, but at least the members are given ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
The stat bonuses are small, but can be very useful for beginning adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
因为氏族由王国管理，所以无法参加攻城战，但至少成员可以获得^3131FF属性加成^000000。
虽然加成很小，但对于初出茅庐的冒险者来说非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
We're named the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000, but we don't discriminate against applicants based on their classes.
The name is just to help you easily choose your Clan.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
我们名为^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000，但并不会根据职业歧视申请者。
这个名字只是为了让你更容易选择氏族。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Berman, enough with the explanation. Let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
伯曼，别解释那么多了。我们去格拉斯特海姆逛逛吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
... Hey.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
……喂。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ooh, you're scaring me.
Berman, call me when you can!~
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
噢，吓死我了。
伯曼，你有空的时候叫我哦！~

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Hah hah, I apologize for their bickering.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哈哈，抱歉让他们吵起来了。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Do you have a question?
If you're tired of traveling alone, join us! You can join and leave the Clan anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你有什么问题吗？
如果你厌倦了独自旅行，就加入我们吧！你可以随时加入或退出氏族。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
The ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000 mainly helps supportive classes.
We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000主要帮助辅助型职业。
我们为新人提供^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
As I told you earlier, Clans cannot join the Siege because they already belong to the Kingdom.
If you want to be in the Siege, then I recommend you join a regular guild.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
正如我之前所说，氏族因为隶属于王国，所以无法参加攻城战。
如果你想参加攻城战，我建议你加入普通的公会。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Do you understand what the Clans are about now?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
现在你明白氏族是做什么的了吗？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Great!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
太好了！
那我们来看看氏族政策，开始入会手续吧。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参加攻城战。
作为我们的新成员，你将获得以下属性加成：^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你同意吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you agree to maintain good standing in the Clan?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你可以随时加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超过2周^000000未登录，你将^FF0000被开除^000000。
你同意在氏族中保持良好的状态吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Now, please write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
那么，请在这里写下你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
^3131FF{0}^000000! What a good name!
Okay, then...
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF{0}^000000！真是个好名字！
那么，接下来...

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Oh, no.
In order to join, you first have to leave your current guild.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哦，不行。
要加入氏族，你必须先退出你当前的公会。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You're already in a Clan.
You're just confused, right?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你已经在一个氏族里了。
你只是搞混了吧？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Welcome to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000!
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
欢迎来到^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000！

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你可以按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000查看氏族信息。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Please remember the few precautions I gave you, and enjoy your Clan activities!
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
请记住我刚才提到的注意事项，享受你的氏族活动吧！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
With meeting, there is parting.
I hope you enjoyed your time in the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
Now, should I process your withdrawal?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
有相聚就有离别。
希望你在^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000的时光是愉快的。
那么，我现在为你办理退出手续吗？

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can't leave the Clan without joining it first.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你还没加入氏族，不能退出。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
I'm sorry, but I can't remove you from another Clan...
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
很抱歉，我无法将你从其他氏族中移除...

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
It's processed.
Come back anytime to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000. I'll be here.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
已经办理好了。
随时欢迎回到^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Hi, there! I'm Shaam, master of the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
嗨！我是沙姆，^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000的师父。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族资讯

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Crossbow Clan
scripts.translation: 关于十字弓氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The Clans were established by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to...
Raffam, why were our ^3131FFclans^000000 made?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
氏族是由卢恩·米德加兹王国建立的，用来...
拉法姆，我们的^3131FF氏族^000000是为了什么而建立的？

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Did you sleep in class? Gosh.
The Clans help lone adventurers connect with each other and share information.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
上课睡觉了吗？真是的。
氏族帮助孤独的冒险者彼此联系并分享信息。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
A-ha, got it! Thank you, Captain!
You heard that too, right?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
啊哈，明白了！谢谢你，船长！
你也听到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Run by the Kingdom itself, the Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege, but the good news is that the members are given some ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
氏族由王国直接管理，不允许参与攻城战，但好消息是成员会获得一些^3131FF属性加成^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
In case you wonder if the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 only recruits Archers, no, it doesn't.
All the Clans accept all classes. You can choose the one that suits your needs best.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
如果你想知道^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000是否只招募弓箭手，答案是：不。
所有氏族都接受所有职业。你可以选择最适合你需求的那个。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
That should cover everything there is to know.
Berman, let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
该说的都说了。
伯曼，我们去格拉斯特海姆逛逛吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You...
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你...

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ooh, scary! You're so protective of your brother.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
哇，好可怕！你对哥哥真是保护欲满满啊。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 is ideal for ranged classes.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000非常适合远程职业。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Eh, let me check the Clan manual. Ah, and we offer stat bonuses to new members: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
嗯，让我查一下氏族手册。啊，对了，我们为新人提供属性加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege; you should join a private guild instead for Siege.
The Clans are for adventurers that hate being tied down.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
氏族不允许参与攻城战；如果你想参加攻城战，应该加入私人公会。
氏族适合那些讨厌被束缚的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Do you have a question?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Oh, yeah? Good choice!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
哦，是吗？不错的选择！
那我们来查看一下氏族政策，开始入会手续吧。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参与攻城战。
作为我们的新成员，你将获得以下属性加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你同意吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you promise you'll maintain good standing?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你可以随时加入或离开氏族，但如果^FF0000超过2周^000000未登录，你将被^FF0000除名^000000。
你保证会保持良好状态吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Good, write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
很好，在这里签上你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
^3131FF{0}^000000..!
Ugh, your penmanship needs work. Let me process your application.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
^3131FF{0}^000000...！
啧，你的字真难认。让我来处理你的申请。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Did you finish things up with your guild?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你和公会那边都处理好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Eh, you're already in a Clan. Hey, this isn't funny.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
嗯，你已经在氏族里了。嘿，这不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Welcome to the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
欢迎来到^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你可以按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000查看氏族信息。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Don't pick fights with other clansmen. Be social.
If you need help, you can always whisper me, okay? See you around!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
不要和其他氏族成员打架。要友善。
如果需要帮助，随时可以密语我，好吗？再见！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
All right then. I'm just going to go have some fun.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
那么，我就去玩了。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ah, do you need time to think about this? No problem.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
啊，你需要时间考虑一下吗？没问题。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Why, did you find a better Clan?
I'm disappointed, but it's your call. Let me process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
怎么，你找到了更好的氏族？
我很失望，但这是你的选择。让我来处理你的退会申请。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
I can't let you leave--you're not even in my Clan!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
我不能让你离开——你甚至不在我的氏族里！

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Sorry, but I don't meddle with other Clans' business.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
抱歉，我不干涉其他氏族的事务。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
It's done.
If you ever miss us, don't hesitate to come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
手续办好了。
如果你以后想我们了，随时欢迎回来，好吗？

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。
